description: Returns the full details of one existing booking: hotel, dates, rooms, guests, contact person, total price, payment status (`PAID`, `PENDING`, or `CREDIT_LINE` for a confirmed booking charged to a partner credit line, settled per statement via `GET /api/b2b/credit-line/statement`), and the cancellation policy (including any cancellation fees and the free-cancellation deadline). Required: `bookingId` (from `list_bookings`). Needs a registered LockTrip account session; guest sessions cannot view booking details. Without a signed-in session, pass the user's `email` instead: LockTrip emails them a sign-in link to their bookings on locktrip.com, and the result has `magicLinkSent: true` (nothing is shown or changed in this chat). Informational only. Use this to read the fee/refund terms BEFORE cancelling, since `cancel_booking` itself does not return a fee preview.

email.description: The user's LockTrip account email. Needed only when there is no signed-in session: LockTrip then emails that address a sign-in link to the user's bookings on locktrip.com (the bookings are not shown in this chat).
